lines.japanese: 「やあん、やぁ、なんでえ……」
lines.english: “Aah, no... Why...?”

lines.japanese: 女たちは私の体にすがり、ぬえぬえと甲高い声で鳴きちらしていた。
lines.english: The women clung to my body, keening *mew-mew* in shrill voices.

lines.japanese: 「どうしてえ、ああん、気持ちいいことしないのお？」
lines.english: “Why won't you do anything that feels good?”

lines.japanese: 「だ、黙れ雌豚、奈落へ落ちろ！」
lines.english: “S-silence, sow! Fall into the abyss!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃあ！」
lines.english: “Aah!”

lines.japanese: 私は自らの体に筋力強化の術をかけ（その瞬間、私はマナが希薄であることをうっかり忘れていたので首尾よく魔法は効力を発揮したのだ）、淫魔たちの束縛を蹴散らした。
lines.english: I cast a spell of muscular enhancement upon my body. (At that instant, I carelessly forgot that mana was scarce, and thus the magic worked perfectly.) I kicked free of the succubi's bonds.

lines.japanese: 「だ、誰ぞ！　誰ぞある！」
lines.english: “S-someone! Is anyone there?”

lines.japanese: 転げおちるようにベッドから抜けだし、臣下の者に召集をかける。
lines.english: I tumbled from the bed as though falling out of it and called my retainers to assemble.

lines.japanese: 「誰でもよい、誰かおらぬか！　ホークは！　イーグルは！　ファルコンは──」
lines.english: “Anyone will do! Is no one there? Hawk! Eagle! Falcon—”

lines.japanese: そして私は不意に、この狂った饗宴の目的を思いだした。
lines.english: And abruptly I remembered the purpose of this mad feast.

lines.japanese: 「──ファルコン！　あの小ざかしき愚弟！」
lines.english: “—Falcon! That impertinent little brother!”

lines.japanese: そうだ、私はあの男に負けてはならぬのだ。やつごときに為しえた蛮行が、この優れた兄に出来ぬはずはない。それを実証するのだ。
lines.english: Yes. I could not permit that man to best me. If a brute such as he had accomplished this barbarous deed, surely his superior elder brother could do the same. I would prove it.

lines.japanese: 戴冠するは我にあり！　私は威儀を正し、喉のつかえを除き、一度は背を向けた寝台に此度こそ正面から対峙した。
lines.english: The crown shall be mine! I composed myself in regal dignity, cleared the catch from my throat, and this time faced the bed I had once fled head-on.

lines.japanese: 「うぉふん！　聞け、雌豚ども。これより王の前に尻を向ける非礼、許してつかわす」
lines.english: “Ahem! Hear me, sows. Henceforth, I grant you leave to commit the discourtesy of turning your backsides upon your king.”

lines.japanese: 火照った体を持てあまして、ぬえぬえと鳴きささめく淫魔たちに声高く宣戦した。
lines.english: I loudly declared war upon the overheated succubi, who were at a loss for what to do with themselves and mewling *mew-mew* among themselves.

lines.japanese: 「貴様らの醜悪なるヴァギナ、我が前に疾く並べよ。王家の祝福を授かったこの聖なるペニスが、奈落の名に懸けて、うぬら毒婦の邪念を打ちくだいてくれる。さあさあ、並べ並べ、ぺしんぺしん」
lines.english: “Line up your hideous vaginas before me at once. By the Abyss, this sacred penis, blessed by the royal house, shall shatter the wicked thoughts of you venomous women. Come, come—form a line. Smack, smack.”

lines.japanese: 私は実直な羊飼いのごとく、四つん這いになった淫魔たちの尻を優しく打って横一列に整列させた。ぬえぬえ鳴きながら三つの丸い尻が揺れている。
lines.english: Like an honest shepherd, I gently smacked the buttocks of the succubi on all fours and arranged them in a row. Three round backsides swayed as they mewled *mew-mew*.

lines.japanese: 「はやくう……ああん、はやく入れてよう……」
lines.english: “Hurry... ahh, hurry and put it in...”

lines.japanese: 「さて、ふむん……」
lines.english: “Now then. Hmm...”

lines.japanese: 私は視線を一巡させたのち、もっとも手前の淫魔を第一目標に選んだ。
lines.english: I surveyed the line and selected the nearest demon as my first objective.

lines.japanese: その腰を片手で支え、残る手で自分の陰茎を掴んだ。私のそれは、淫魔の第二の唇から漏れるメスの異臭に怯え縮こまっていた。だが私は王だ、負けるわけにはゆかない。
lines.english: I supported her hips with one hand and grasped my penis with the other. It had cowered and shriveled before the alien female reek leaking from the succubus's second lips. But I was king. I could not lose.

lines.japanese: 「行くぞ女！　はああっ！」
lines.english: “Here I come, woman! Haaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 気合一閃、槍の穂先を淫魔の吸精口へ叩きこむ。だが芯の通っていない柔らかな武器はそこへ突きたたず、へなりと肉の壁に弾かれて脇へ逸れた。
lines.english: With a flash of fighting spirit, I drove my lancehead at the succubus's seed-sucking mouth. Yet my soft weapon, lacking any rigid core, would not thrust home. It wilted against the wall of flesh and glanced aside.

lines.japanese: 「やだあ、焦らさないではやく入れてええ」
lines.english: “No fair—stop teasing and hurry up and put it in!”

lines.japanese: 「ちっ、やるな女！　だが俺たちの戦いはこれからだ！」
lines.english: “Tch. A worthy defense, woman! But our battle has only begun!”

lines.japanese: 私は諦めなかった。そこから逃げなかった。攻撃の手を止めなかった（なぜなら努力はいつか報われるとフリッキー５の歌にもあるからです）。
lines.english: I did not surrender. I did not flee. I did not cease my attack. (For the songs of Fricky Five also tell us that effort shall one day be rewarded.)

lines.japanese: 「ラッシャァァァ！　ラッシャァァァ！」
lines.english: “Raaaaagh! Raaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 勇猛果敢なヘラ族の狩猟祭りもかくやという吶喊の叫びをあげて、私は淫魔の第二の喉に幾度も幾度も、するどい（気がします）切っ先を突きさした。
lines.english: With a charging cry worthy of the valiant hunting festival of the Hera tribe, I stabbed my sharp (I believe) point again and again at the succubus's second throat.

lines.japanese: 「ガルッ、ガルッ、ガルゥゥゥッ！」
lines.english: “Gar! Gar! Garrrrr!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはは！　どうだ女、俺のホーリーランスの威力は！　庶民どものポイズンダガーなどとは比べ物にもならんだろう。気をやったか、そうら、気をやったか！」
lines.english: “Bwahaha! What say you, woman, to the might of my Holy Lance? It is beyond comparison with the Poison Daggers of common men. Hast thou fainted? There now—hast thou fainted?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あんっ、そこじゃ、ないっ……あ、あふ、そこ、入ってない……い、いやっ！　もっと、もっと……ああんっ！　ちゃんと入れてえ！　んあっ、おねがい、硬いの奥まで入れてよお！」
lines.english: “Ah—ahh, not there... You're not inside... N-no! More, more... Ahh! Put it in properly! Please—put the hard thing all the way inside me!”

lines.japanese: さしもの淫魔も私の練達した閨房術の前には為すすべがないらしく、まんふまんふと体をわななかせて善がりくるった。
lines.english: Even the succubus appeared helpless before my consummate arts of the bedchamber, her body trembling *mmph-mmph* as she writhed madly in pleasure.

lines.japanese: 「もはは、早よう気をやれ、気をやるのだ！　そうらゲイ、ボル、ク！　ゲイ、ボル、ク！」
lines.english: “Mohaha! Faint quickly! Faint, I say! There—Gae... Bol... ga! Gae... Bol... ga!”

lines.japanese: 「あははぁ～ん、いっ、入れてよう……ぐすっ、あう、ぐすっ……じら、焦らさないでえ、もおー……」
lines.english: “Ahh... p-put it in... sniff... ahh, sniff... D-don't tease me anymore...”

lines.japanese: 涙ぐんだ嬌声のただよう中、不意に背後で古びた蝶番が軋んだ。
lines.english: Amid the tearful cries of pleasure, an old hinge suddenly groaned behind me.

lines.japanese: 私は（そこらの庶民などよりはるかに雄々しく）腰を振るいながら、わずかに首を曲げて視界の隅に音の発生源を収めた。
lines.english: I kept working my hips (far more manfully than any commoner) and bent my neck just enough to catch the source of the sound at the edge of my vision.

lines.japanese: 黒光りする革の短衣をまとった中年女が、重い鉄扉を開けはなち、足音高く部屋へ入ってきた。すぐ後ろに、その女より頭ふたつほど高い長身の男が続く。
lines.english: A middle-aged woman in a short coat of glossy black leather flung open the heavy iron door and strode loudly into the room. Directly behind her came a tall man nearly two heads taller than she was.

lines.japanese: 「ふッ、ふウッ、フェニックスか、何用だ、ふッ、余は、戦の、さなかであるッ」
lines.english: “Ph-Phoenix? What business hast thou—hah—We are—hah—in the midst of battle!”

lines.japanese: 私は淫魔の喉に聖なる槍を抜き刺ししながら告げた。彼は赤い照明の下の石壁にもたれ、こちらに頬を向けた角度から答える。
lines.english: I spoke as I drew my sacred lance from the succubus's throat and stabbed it in again. Leaning against the stone wall beneath the red light, Phoenix answered with one cheek turned toward me.

lines.japanese: 「それだ。王の戦とやらを視察しに来た。構うな、続けろ」
lines.english: “That battle is precisely what I came to inspect. Pay me no mind. Continue.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、ふッ、良きに、計らえ」
lines.english: “I see—hah. Then—hah—do as thou pleasest.”

lines.japanese: 「ラッシャァァァ！　ワラッシャァァァ！」
lines.english: “Raaaaagh! Waraaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 言われたとおり、私は彼らを構わないことにした。どのみちこれは私自身の孤独な戦争なのだ（もっとも人生とは、老いさらばえ死にゆくまでただ撃ちつ撃たれつを繰りかえすだけの不毛な消耗戦です）。
lines.english: As instructed, I paid them no heed. In any event, this was my own solitary war. (Life, after all, is merely a barren war of attrition in which one trades fire until age and death overtake us.)

lines.japanese: 私は肉と粘液に弾かれる己が武器を見下ろして、人間と人間が繋がるのはなんて難しいのだろうと思った（何故だか表情筋が突っ張って、笑い顔を維持するのが難しくなってきました）。
lines.english: I looked down upon my weapon, forever repelled by flesh and slime, and wondered why it was so difficult for one human being to connect with another. (For some reason, my facial muscles had begun to tighten, making my smile difficult to maintain.)

lines.japanese: 「ラッシャァァァ……ラッシャァァァ……」
lines.english: “Raaaaagh... Raaaaagh...”

lines.japanese: 「ねえカケル、あの子大丈夫なの？　そもそも何者なのよ彼」
lines.english: “Kakeru, is that boy all right? Who is he, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「伊丹伽楼羅。己を王と信じる哀れな道化」
lines.english: “Karura Itami. A pitiable clown who believes himself a king.”

lines.japanese: 「やだ……なぁに、それ」
lines.english: “Oh, no... What is that supposed to mean?”

lines.japanese: 「だが、やつの耳目を通した世界においては、たしかにやつが王だ。そうだろう？　たとえ荒唐無稽な夢想でも、脳がそれを疑わず現実だと認識してしまえば、その時点でそれはやつにとって虚構でなくなる……」
lines.english: “Yet within the world perceived through his own eyes and ears, he truly is king. Is he not? However absurd the fantasy, once the brain accepts it without doubt as reality, it ceases at that moment to be fiction for him...”

lines.japanese: 「周囲を変えるより自分を変える方が合理的であり、また現実的だ。ハハハ！　なあ、あれは一種、人類が理想とするべき生き方だと思わねえか？　皆が皆、自らの国をひとつ持ち、その世界の王として君臨するのだ」
lines.english: “Changing oneself is more rational—and more practical—than changing one's surroundings. Hahaha! Don't you think his is, in a sense, the life humanity ought to aspire to? Every person possessing one country of his own, reigning as king over that world.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、おかしな喋り方。あなた一年以上会わないうちに、すっかりキャラ変えちゃったのね」
lines.english: “Hee hee. What's with the funny way of talking? I haven't seen you in over a year and you've completely changed your whole act.”

lines.japanese: 「それがいまの若い子たちの流行りなのかしら。カケルとあのお友達、なんだか似てるわ」
lines.english: “Is that the fashion among young people now? You and that friend of yours seem rather alike, Kakeru.”

lines.japanese: 「似てるか……クク、そう言われて悪い気はしねえが、ひとつ決定的な違いがある。やつはオリジナルだが、俺は所詮その模造品に過ぎない」
lines.english: “Alike...? Heh. I can’t say I dislike the comparison, but there is one decisive difference. He is the original. In the end, I am only an imitation.”

lines.japanese: 「え……あらまあ見てカケル、本当に可哀想よあの子……腰振りながら泣いてるじゃない……」
lines.english: “Oh... Kakeru, look. That poor boy... He's crying while he thrusts...”

lines.japanese: 「あれって女嫌いとかそんな簡単な問題じゃないわよね、言っちゃえばセックス恐怖症でしょう。カケル、何のお仕置きか知らないけど、もうこの辺で勘弁してあげなさいな」
lines.english: “It's not as simple as him disliking women, is it? You might even call it a fear of sex. Kakeru, I don't know what you're punishing him for, but give him a break already.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、馬鹿な！　こんな茶番、俺が進んで膳立てするものかよ。やつはやつなりに、テメエの殻を破ろうとしてるんだろう」
lines.english: “Hah! Don't be absurd. Why would I go out of my way to stage this farce? He's trying, in his own fashion, to break out of his shell.”

lines.japanese: 「いやだわ、そういうの聞いたことある。卵の殻を破れない雛鳥は死ぬのよ」
lines.english: “Oh, dear. I’ve heard that one before. A chick that cannot break its shell dies.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、それはいい寓話だなあマダム。ク、ハハ、ハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Oh? An excellent parable, madam. Heh—hahaha! Hahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「笑いごとじゃないわ。ねえカケル、お友達に言ってちょうだい。うちの女の子たちだって体張って仕事してるんだから、せめてその分ぐらい優しく、心を込めて気持ち良くしてあげてほしいのよ」
lines.english: “This isn't funny. Kakeru, tell your friend something for me. My girls put their bodies on the line for this work. The least he can do is treat them gently and put his heart into making them feel good.”

lines.japanese: 「あん？　そりゃあ連中の催淫が足りねえんだろ。もっと景気よくクスリぶっ込めよ」
lines.english: “Huh? Then the drugs haven't made them horny enough. Pump them full of something stronger.”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ、無茶言ってくれる……あのねえ、すでにあの子たち、ＯＤすれすれでキメてるのよ？　それぞれの適量をミリグラム単位で割りだした最高のカクテルをね。もうとっくに頭はどろどろ、体はとろとろだわ」
lines.english: “My, what impossible demands... Those girls are already dosed within a hair of an OD, you know? The finest cocktail, calculated to the milligram for each of them. Their brains are mush and their bodies are melting already.”

lines.japanese: 「うちのスタッフはみんな、男性を悦ばせることに誇りを持ってこの仕事やってるし、音も匂いも照明も最高レベルのセッティングなの。これ以上はお客さんに上手いことやっていただかないと無理だわよ」
lines.english: “Every woman on my staff takes pride in pleasing men, and the sound, scent, and lighting are all set to the highest standard. Past that, the customer simply has to do his part.”

lines.japanese: 「マダム、貴様の首の皺が増えたのは明らかだが、耳まで遠くなってきたのか？　俺は投薬が足りねえと言ったんだ、女どもにシャブでもゴメでも追い打ちしてやれ」
lines.english: “Madam, the wrinkles on your neck have plainly multiplied, but is your hearing going too? I said they haven't had enough. Give them another hit of meth or Foxy.”

lines.japanese: 「もう……素人は量さえ増やせばいいと思ってる。私ＯＤすれすれって言ったでしょ、分かる？　ＯＤ、オーバードーズ。現時点でもう、過剰摂取の一歩手前なの。だからこれ以上は入れても逆効果」
lines.english: “Honestly... Amateurs think increasing the dose solves everything. I said they were within a hair of an OD, remember? Do you understand? OD. Overdose. They are already one step from taking too much. Anything more will only be counterproductive.”

lines.japanese: 「それにね、うちは非合法なことしてても非人道的なことはしない主義なの。あの子たちみんな、まだ嫁入り前の体だし、今はまだこんな仕事しててもそのうち素敵な恋に──」
lines.english: “Besides, our policy is that while we may do illegal things, we never do anything inhumane. Those girls are all still unmarried. They may be doing this work now, but someday they could find a wonderful love—”

lines.japanese: 「ゴメを追加しろ、マダム。やるのか、やらないのか、それ以外は喋るな」
lines.english: “Give them more Foxy, madam. Do it or refuse. Say nothing else.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさいカケル、やれないわ。ゴメでバッドに入っちゃったら、気が狂うほどの恐ろしいサイケ地獄が待ってるの。自我を保てなくなったらセックスどころじゃない、下手したら呼吸することさえ忘れるんだから」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, Kakeru. I can't. If Foxy gives them a bad trip, they'll be trapped in a psychedelic hell terrifying enough to drive them mad. Once they can no longer hold on to themselves, sex is out of the question. They might even forget to breathe.”

lines.japanese: 「ふん……だったら、せめてニトライトでも嗅がせろ」
lines.english: “Hmph... Then at least let them inhale some poppers.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうね……ううん、でも……」
lines.english: “Ah, yes... No, but...”

lines.japanese: 「ニトライトでブーストかけて、女をむりやり果てさせるんだよ。マダム、二年前、首が回らなくなったおまえの借金を肩代わりしてやったのは誰だ。やれ」
lines.english: “Boost them with the poppers and force them over the edge. Madam, who paid off your debts two years ago when you were in over your head? Do it.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、それ言われちゃうと反論できないけど……でも、これだってすでに結構な量……あんまり無茶すると視神経にダメージ残るし──」
lines.english: “Yes, when you put it that way I can't argue... But this is already quite a lot. If we push it too far, they could be left with optic-nerve damage—”

lines.japanese: 「貸せ」
lines.english: “Give it to me.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、カケル……！」
lines.english: “Kakeru...!”

lines.japanese: 背後から足音が近づいてくる。目をやると、フェニックスが石の壁を離れていた。片手には親指大のごく小さな瓶が握られている。黄色いラベルに黒い蓋。
lines.english: Footsteps approached behind me. I looked and saw Phoenix leave the stone wall. In one hand he held a tiny bottle no larger than his thumb: yellow label, black cap.

lines.japanese: おそらく彼は、持久戦の様相を呈してきたこの状況を見かね、戦略的撤退を促しに来たのだろう。私は（いつの間にか）顔を濡らしていた雫を手の甲で拭いながら告げた。
lines.english: Presumably, seeing that the situation had become a war of attrition, he had come to urge a strategic retreat. I wiped with the back of my hand the drops that had somehow wet my face and addressed him.

lines.japanese: 「ま、待ってくれフェニックス。もう少しだ、もう少しでこの淫魔は気をやるのだ、まち、間違いない──」
lines.english: “W-wait, Phoenix. I am nearly there. Just a little more and this succubus will faint. Of that there can be no d-doubt—”

lines.japanese: 「続けろ」
lines.english: “Continue.”

lines.japanese: だが彼は私の横を無関心に通りすぎ、玉の汗を浮かべて身悶える淫魔の正面に回りこんだ。
lines.english: But he passed me without interest and stepped around in front of the succubus, whose body writhed beneath beads of sweat.

lines.japanese: 「きゃあん！？」
lines.english: “Aah?!”

lines.japanese: 女の髪を前から乱暴に引っつかみ、残る片手で小瓶の蓋を外して鼻先へ突きつける。
lines.english: He seized the woman's hair roughly from the front, uncapped the bottle with his free hand, and thrust it beneath her nose.

lines.japanese: 「嗅げ」
lines.english: “Smell it.”

lines.japanese: 「ひっ？　は、はい……すうううっ……！」
lines.english: “Eek? Y-yes... Hnnnn!”

lines.japanese: 淫魔は上の口を閉じ、慣れた仕草で鼻から大きく息を吸いこんだ。彼女が呼吸を止めると、フェニックスは小瓶を引いて私に目を転じた。
lines.english: The succubus closed her upper mouth and, with practiced ease, drew a deep breath through her nose. When she held it, Phoenix withdrew the bottle and turned his eyes to me.

lines.japanese: 「伽楼羅、一気に駆けぬけろ。いまならおまえは飛べる」
lines.english: “Karura, charge through in one stroke. Right now, you can fly.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なに、それはまことか」
lines.english: “Wh-what? Is that true?”

lines.japanese: 女は小瓶の臭気を鼻から吸いこんだまま、息を止めて固まっていた。だが、その剥き出しの肌がたちまち朱の色に染まってゆく。
lines.english: The woman held still, holding her breath with the bottle's fumes in her lungs. Then her naked skin rapidly flushed scarlet.

lines.japanese: 「っぷは！　はあっ！　あああっ！　あああああああっ！」
lines.english: “Hah! Haaah! Aah! Aaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 呼吸を再開させたとき、淫魔は鳴きさけぶ獣のような野性の吠え声を迸らせた。その凄絶な響きは、私の鼓膜と全身を震わせた。
lines.english: When she began breathing again, the succubus loosed the feral howl of a screaming beast. Its terrible resonance shook my eardrums and my entire body.

lines.japanese: 「う、うううっ……」
lines.english: “U-ugh...”

lines.japanese: なんという……なんとういう恐ろしい声、恐ろしい目、恐ろしい肉壷。思わず私は腰がくだけ、無意識のうちに武器を引いて一歩あとじさっていた。
lines.english: What a... What a terrifying voice, terrifying eyes, terrifying fleshy pit. My knees buckled. Without thought, I withdrew my weapon and staggered one step backward.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　なんだ、殻も破れず逃げるのか」
lines.english: “Hah! What's this? Running away without even breaking your shell?”

lines.japanese: 「ち、ちち、違う！　余はグレタガルドの王ぞ、これしきのことで退きはせぬ！」
lines.english: “N-n-no! We are the king of Gretagard. Such a trifle shall not make Us retreat!”

lines.japanese: 私は頭を振り、こぶしを握って、自らの士気を鼓舞した。
lines.english: I shook my head, clenched my fists, and roused my own morale.

lines.japanese: 戦えガルーダ、負けるなガルーダ、正義の怒りをぶつけろガルーダ！
lines.english: Fight, Garuda! Do not lose, Garuda! Strike with the wrath of justice, Garuda!

lines.japanese: 「ぶ、ぶもははは！　喰らえ淫魔、この賢者王ガルーダが貴様らのまたぐらに風穴を開けてくれるわ！」
lines.english: “B-bwohahaha! Take this, succubus! Garuda the Sage King shall punch a great hole straight through your crotch!”

lines.japanese: 「スクリュー・ランサー！！」
lines.english: “Screw Lancer!”

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！」
lines.english: “Aah!”

lines.japanese: 「スパイラル・アンカー！！」
lines.english: “Spiral Anchor!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああッ！！」
lines.english: “A-aah!”

lines.japanese: 「ハイパー・グングニル・バスタァァァ！！」
lines.english: “Hyper Gungnir Busterrrr!”

lines.japanese: 「ああああぁぁぁぁぁぁ……ッ！！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaaaaah...!”

lines.japanese: こうして我々は辛くも淫魔の野望を打ちくだいたが、その勝利は決して後味の良いものではなかった──
lines.english: Thus did we narrowly crush the succubi's ambitions, though victory left no sweetness behind—

lines.japanese: ──そして地下室を出てから気付いたことだが、私はまだ射精をしていなかった。
lines.english: —and only after leaving the underground room did I realize that I had still not ejaculated.

lines.japanese: 「ううむ、勝敗に関わらず、いつの世も戦のあとは虚しいものだのう」
lines.english: “Hmm. Victory or defeat, war has left men hollow in every age.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、良いことを思いついたぞ。この漫然とした憔悴感を除去するため、ひと暴れするとしよう。ファルコンが遊んでいた黒い小僧共がいただろう。おい聞いているかフェニックス。俺はまだ童貞と呼ばれているか」
lines.english: “Ah! An excellent thought has struck me. To dispel this vague exhaustion, let us go on a rampage. There were those black-clad boys Falcon played with, were there not? Phoenix, art thou listening? Am I still to be called a virgin?”

lines.japanese: 「黒い小僧……ハッ、カラスの信者たちか？」
lines.english: “Black-clad boys...? Hah. The Crow’s followers?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことは知らぬ。余は童貞であるかと聞いておるのだ」
lines.english: “I know nothing of that. I asked whether We remain a virgin.”

lines.japanese: 「ふん、すでに白旗を掲げている弱者に手をかけるのは俺の趣味じゃねえが……王の頼みとあっちゃあ、無視できねえなあ」
lines.english: “Hmph. Striking the weak after they've already raised the white flag isn't to my taste... But when the king asks, I can hardly ignore him.”

lines.japanese: 「さようか……童貞……ふむん、無念であるな……」
lines.english: “I see... A virgin... Hmm. How regrettable...”
